name: PLATO MIPFEAS Benchmark
description: Evaluates MIP solvers on finding any feasible integer solution for 233 feasible instances from MIPLIB2017, within a 600-second time limit. Performance is measured via the PRIMARY INTEGRAL metric (area under the primal bound curve over time), rewarding solvers that find good feasible solutions quickly rather than only proving optimality. Both open-source and commercial solvers, including GPU-accelerated implementations, are compared.
typical_sota_score: Best commercial solvers (COPT, CPLEX, Xpress) find feasible solutions in 192–227 of 233 instances within 600 seconds.
reputation: High-profile MILP feasibility benchmark based on the MIPLIB2017 test set; regularly updated by Hans Mittelmann.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. GPU solver (cuOpt) included. Hardware: AMD EPYC 9B45 (24 threads). PRIMARY INTEGRAL metric penalises late feasible solutions.
